ValidationRule.description: Rule to make Reference Product and Reference Type mandatory when client reference field is checked.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.ContactValidations__c = false, NSP_Client_Reference__c = true,OR(ISBLANK( NSP_Reference_Products__c ),ISBLANK( NSP_Reference_Type__c )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select a value for Reference Product and Reference Type.
